VG:RV:SAK:M01:S024:V006.sanskrit: na̱hi te̍ kṣa̱traṁ na saho̱ na ma̱nyuṁ vaya̍ś ca̱nāmī pa̱taya̍nta ā̱puḥ | nemā āpo̍ animi̱ṣaṁ cara̍ntī̱r na ye vāta̍sya prami̱nanty abhva̍m ||
VG:RV:SAK:M01:S024:V006.translation: Ne'er have those birds that fly through air attained to thy high dominion or thy might or spirit; Nor these the waters that flow on for ever, nor hills, abaters of the wind's wild fury.

VG:RV:SAK:M01:S035:V005.sanskrit: vi janā̍ñ chyā̱vāḥ śi̍ti̱pādo̍ akhya̱n ratha̱ṁ hira̍ṇyapraüga̱ṁ vaha̍ntaḥ | śaśva̱d viśa̍ḥ savi̱tur daivya̍syo̱pasthe̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni tasthuḥ ||
VG:RV:SAK:M01:S035:V005.translation: Drawing the gold-yoked car his Bays, white-footed, have manifested light to all the peoples. Held in the lap of Savitar, divine One, all men, all beings have their place for ever.

VG:RV:SAK:M01:S051:V009.sanskrit: anu̍vratāya ra̱ndhaya̱nn apa̍vratān ā̱bhūbhi̱r indra̍ḥ śna̱thaya̱nn anā̍bhuvaḥ | vṛ̱ddhasya̍ ci̱d vardha̍to̱ dyām ina̍kṣata̱ḥ stavā̍no va̱mro vi ja̍ghāna sa̱ṁdiha̍ḥ ||
VG:RV:SAK:M01:S051:V009.translation: Indra gives up the lawless to the pious man, destroying by the Strong Ones those who have no strength. Vamra when glorified destroyed the gathered piles of the still waxing great one who would reach the heaven.

VG:RV:SAK:M01:S061:V003.sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ tyam u̍pa̱maṁ sva̱rṣām bharā̍my āṅgū̱ṣam ā̱sye̍na | maṁhi̍ṣṭha̱m accho̍ktibhir matī̱nāṁ su̍vṛ̱ktibhi̍ḥ sū̱riṁ vā̍vṛ̱dhadhyai̍ ||
VG:RV:SAK:M01:S061:V003.translation: To him then with my lips mine adoration, winning heaven's light, most excellent, I offer, To magnify with songs of invocation and with fair hymns the Lord, most bounteous Giver.

VG:RV:SAK:M01:S068:V009.sanskrit: pi̱tur na pu̱trāḥ kratu̍ṁ juṣanta̱ śroṣa̱n ye a̍sya̱ śāsa̍ṁ tu̱rāsa̍ḥ ||
